By VICTORIA CHURCHILL, US POLITICAL REPORTER

President Donald Trump shared on Sunday that he was delighted with the decision of Google Maps to accept his renaming of Lake Ontario to 'Lake America.'

Google Maps made the switch from Lake Ontario's name to Lake America for US users following an executive renaming order from Trump last week, and the president posted a screen grab of the change on his Truth Social account on Sunday.

Trump announced the move on Thursday, signing an executive order directing the Interior Department to adopt 'Lake America' as the body of water's name for US federal purposes amid ongoing trade disputes with America's northern neighbor.

The order does not compel Canada or any international organization to adopt the new name, and Canadian officials have spoken out against the move.
